payload.core_mechanism_summary: Counts fixed points. If not all fixed, checks for a pair (i, a[i]) where a[a[i]] == i to add 2 fixed points; else adds 1.
payload.rationale: Solution is a linear-time greedy algorithm, not a complete search; but among given subtypes, permutation enumeration is the closest due to the problem's permutation context, though poorly matched.
